hints.astronaut: Float in slow motion with heavy, clumsy steps, tap an imaginary helmet, then bounce on the moon and plant a flag.
hints.magician: Pull something out of a hat or from behind an ear, wave a wand with a flourish, then take a bow.
hints.archaeologist: Kneel and brush dirt away very gently with a small brush, dig carefully, then lift up a find and examine it closely.
hints.lifeguard: Sit up high scanning the water with a hand over your eyes, blow a whistle, then run, swim out and pull someone to shore.
hints.translator: Listen carefully with a hand at your ear, then turn and gesture for the other person, going back and forth between two people.
hints.conductor: Stand in front of a big orchestra, raise a baton, wave it in time with the music, and cue different sections with your other hand.
hints.puppeteer: Hold your hands up high with fingers moving strings, and make an invisible puppet below walk, dance and bow.
hints.beekeeper: Pull on a bulky veil and gloves, puff smoke from a smoker, lift a frame out of a hive and slowly scrape off honey, ignoring the buzzing.
hints.firefighter: Pull a heavy hose, aim a strong spray at flames, slide down a pole, and carry someone out on your shoulder.
hints.dentist: Gesture for someone to open wide, peer into their mouth with a little mirror, drill with a steady hand, and pull a tooth.
hints.pilot: Hold a steering wheel in front of you, flick switches overhead, press a headset to your ear, and tilt for a landing.
hints.plumber: Crouch under a sink, tighten a pipe with a big wrench, get splashed, and pull a plunger up and down.
hints.photographer: Hold a camera to your eye, crouch and lean for the best angle, wave people into a pose, and click.
hints.judge: Bang a gavel, sit up straight in a long robe, listen to both sides sternly, and point firmly to give a verdict.
hints.tailor: Measure a person with a tape around the shoulders and waist, hold up pins in your mouth, and sew with a needle and thread.
hints.referee: Blow a whistle, run along with the players, wave a card in the air, and point firmly to one side.
hints.teacher: Write on a board, point at students, and tap a ruler on the desk.
hints.doctor: Listen to a heartbeat with a stethoscope, check a throat, and write a prescription.
hints.cook: Chop with a knife, stir a pot, taste, and add a pinch of salt.
hints.driver: Hold a big steering wheel, shift gears, glance in the mirror, and press the brakes.
hints.farmer: Dig with a hoe, scatter seeds, wipe your sweaty forehead, and harvest the crops.
hints.singer: Hold a microphone to your mouth, sway to the beat, and bow to a cheering crowd.
hints.painter: Hold a brush and a palette, dab at a canvas, step back, and tilt your head.
hints.barber: Snip scissors around someone's head, brush off their neck, and shave a beard with a razor.
hints.detective: Lift a magnifying glass, crouch to study a footprint, then tip your hat and point at the culprit.
hints.blacksmith: Hold hot metal with tongs, hammer it on an anvil with big swings, then plunge it into water in a cloud of steam.
hints.sculptor: Chip at a block of stone with a chisel, step back, brush away the dust, and smooth a shape with your hand.
hints.juggler: Toss imaginary balls up in a circle, keep your eyes up, and add one more ball.
hints.stuntman: Jump from somewhere high, roll on the ground, then stand up dazed and give a thumbs-up.
hints.lumberjack: Swing a heavy axe at a tree trunk, wipe your forehead, then step back and point as the tree falls.
